testcases.notes: PR L0 repro for Z-Image-Turbo. Uses the same checkpoint, Qwen3 text encoder, ZImage DiT/VAE path, runner, comparator, full 256-token cache shape, guidance_scale=0.0, 9-step Turbo recipe, and FP32 selectors as the full manifest. L0 uses 512px to reduce DiT/VAE spatial scale; nightly keeps 1024px coverage.
